name: SEO Rank Hunter
author: Adnan Hyder Pervez

sections.description:
SEO Rank Hunter helps you improve on‑page SEO and site performance without needing to configure dozens of complex options.

The plugin can:

  1. Automatically generate optimized meta titles and descriptions.
  2. Clean up unnecessary scripts and styles on the front‑end.
  3. Minify HTML, CSS, and JavaScript output where supported by your theme and other plugins.
  4. Add basic security and performance headers.
  5. Provide a simple, clean settings page in the WordPress dashboard.

This plugin is designed to be safe to use with most modern themes and plugins. You can enable or disable individual features from the settings screen under Settings → SEO Rank Hunter.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seo-rank-hunter folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin ZIP via the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → SEO Rank Hunter to configure options.
  4. Clear any server or plugin caches after changing optimization options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace full SEO suites?

SEO Rank Hunter focuses on automated on‑page optimization and performance tweaks. It will work alongside larger SEO suites, but you should avoid enabling overlapping features in multiple plugins at the same time.

Will it work with my caching plugin?

In most cases yes. If you see duplicated minification or broken layouts, try disabling minification in either your caching plugin or in SEO Rank Hunter.

Does it modify my content?

The plugin does not permanently change your posts or pages. It works on the output at runtime, so disabling the plugin restores your site to its previous behavior.
